name: UARL Standings Driver Usernames
notes: Added a mobile-ready /admin/ control center for schedules, results, teams, drivers, paints, history, and rules.
Replaced the shared Admin password with individual staff accounts and secure, HTTP-only sessions.
Added Owner, Admin, and Race Control roles with server-enforced permissions.
Added Owner account management, password resets, account disabling, and a staff activity history.
Publishing now writes directly to persistent Netlify site storage with no GitHub repository required.
Public pages load live published data first and retain data/uarl.json as a safe fallback.
Replaced roster, charter, qualifying, finishes, stages, bonuses, paint tags, and history JSON boxes with visual row builders.
Added driver suggestions, car-number fields, status and charter dropdowns, checkboxes, and add/remove row controls.
Locked every Results driver field to a series-aware dropdown for D1, archived D2, or Open.
Driver selections now fill car numbers automatically while preserving verified historical participants in old official results.
Results now calculate finishing, stage, pole, bonus, DNF, and DNQ points automatically while honoring points eligibility and exhibitions.
Public D1 and Open Series driver displays now sort entries numerically by car number regardless of Admin entry order.
Results now support verified event-only, substitute, and guest drivers without adding them permanently to a series roster.
Event-only drivers become available across winner, pole, qualifying, stage, finish, and bonus dropdowns for that result only.
Standings now use canonical Roblox usernames to combine results entered under usernames, display names, or prior aliases.
Legacy results fall back safely through display name and car number matching, while guest drivers receive stable event identities.
Fixed wins, top-five, top-ten, and average-finish tracking for records that store finish position in the Admin format.
Prevented unresolved guest records from appearing as undefined drivers or blank car-number standings rows.
Added visible warnings when a result participant is missing a canonical Roblox username.
Made guest Roblox usernames required in the visual result workflow.
Publishing now recalculates every race record so stage points cannot remain stale when another result is open.
Finish rows now show stage points separately from the automatic total.
Stage, qualifying, pole, winner, bonus, and finish rows inherit newly added canonical usernames automatically.
Redesigned the public Race Results view around a full-width official finishing table.
Qualifying and stage results now use compact, content-sized session cards without oversized empty areas.
All public classifications sort automatically by recorded position.
Removed repetitive points-eligible labels and now shows a badge only for no-points entrants.
Added visible race, stage, bonus, and total-point columns to the official finish table.
Points standings now show each canonical Roblox username beneath the driver's display name.
Internal guest identity keys remain hidden when a Roblox username has not been supplied.
